# HTTP API

OML serves one JSON API on one keyed listener. `/v1` is the provider ring that agents use: write, read, recall and replace. `/v2` is the lab ring for review, workareas, crews and keys. A request names its workarea in one field, `workarea`, by id or name; omitted, it takes the key's default workarea.

*Generated by `scripts/gen_http_api_reference.py`; edit the source, not this page. Source: `docs/api/openapi.yaml`. It lists 72 operations.*

## Conventions

- **Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The key carries one role (`reader`, `writer`, `dreamer`, `admin`, `operator`); the server derives the tenant from it, never from the request.
- **Idempotency.** Every `POST` that creates state needs an `Idempotency-Key` header. A replay returns the stored answer and sets `Idempotency-Replay: true`.
- **Request ids.** Every response carries `X-Request-Id` and `X-Correlation-Id`. You may send your own `X-Request-Id`, `X-Correlation-Id` and `traceparent`.
- **Errors.** Every failure has one JSON shape with a `code` from the [error codes](errors.md). Any operation can answer `429 limit.rate` or `limit.quota`.
- **Absence.** A read the key may not make answers `404 access.not_found`, the same answer as a missing id.
- **Limits.** Body size, page size and rate bounds are on the [limits page](../reference/limits.md).

## memories

Write, list, recall and replace memories on the provider ring.

| Operation | What it does |
|---|---|
| `POST /v1/memories` | Submit a memory (remember or learn); held on arrival, scanned same-call. |
| `GET /v1/memories` | Structured, paginated listing of memory summaries. |
| `POST /v1/memories/recall` | Ranked retrieval over promoted rows by a named search pipeline; steering rows precede hits, unranked. |
| `GET /v1/memories/{artifact_id}` | One memory with its text (decrypted on the serving path) and attachment descriptors. |
| `POST /v1/memories/{artifact_id}/supersede` | Propose a replacement version, or with retirement true propose retiring the claim; a new attributed submission, held like any write. |
| `POST /v1/memories/{artifact_id}/source-check` | Record that a promoted version's anchored span was compared with its source at a commit. |
| `GET /v1/guardrails` | The guardrails in force at the scope node, under the key's reader access and guardrail scope; never in recall. |

### `POST /v1/memories`

Submit a memory (remember or learn); held on arrival, scanned same-call.

Requires: writer effective access on the resolved workarea; every derives_from ancestor must be readable by the key — promoted within its reader effective access, or its own row in any state — else 404 access.not_found, indistinguishable from a nonexistent id; lineage is attribution, not a verb of its own.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes | Claims an idempotency record (key_id, workarea, idem_key) before side effects. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `verb` | `remember` \| `learn` | no | Omitted, learn when derives_from is non-empty and remember otherwise; a sent verb is honoured. learn requires non-empty derives_from — refused with submission.lineage_required otherwise; a derived conclusion without nameable lineage is remember with kind derived_fact. |
| `claim_key` | string | no | Groups versions of one claim; one live claim per (tenant, workarea): a new claim collides with a held, promoted or demoted version (submission.claim_key_conflict), and a claim whose every version is rejected or erased releases the key (docs/architecture/audit-and-lineage.md). |
| `kind` | `memory` \| `derived_fact` \| `steering` \| `term` \| `term_mapping` \| `vocab_release` \| `guardrail` | no | guardrail requires severity and admits rule (since v0.5.1). |
| `valid_from` | string | no | When the memory begins to hold in the world, as its author declares it: a period names its first instant, so 2015 begins on 1 January 2015. |
| `valid_until` | string | no | When it stops holding: a period names its whole span, so 2015 holds through 31 December 2015 and a day through that day; an instant is exclusive. |
| `severity` | `never` \| `must` \| `should` | no | A guardrail's severity: never and must bind, should is the reviewed default, and it orders the set first; required on kind guardrail except a retirement, refused on every other kind (request.validation, details.field /severity). |
| `rule` | object | no | A guardrail's optional rule in the oml-gr/1 grammar: one tool class, its match and an effect, deny or ask, never allow; should takes ask only. |
| `body` | string | yes | Text body — claim text, at most submission.max_body_size (shipped 1 MiB) UTF-8 bytes of the NFC-normalized body; larger is 413 request.payload_too_large (http-api.md Limits). |
| `workarea` | WorkareaRef | no | The workarea written in, by id or name, honoured only within the key's grants; omitted, the key's default_workarea. |
| `derives_from` | array of string | no | Artifact ids; the declared lineage (omission is undetectable — honesty rule). |
| `on_similar` | `hold` \| `refuse` | no | Omitted, hold. |
| `anchor` | object | no | The origin the author declares: signed in the submission event, immutable per version, shown to the reviewer, never fetched by the server, and clear metadata that crypto-shredding never erases. |
| `format` | string | no | The media type of body, signed with the version and fixed for it: text/plain (the default), text/markdown, text/vnd.oml.mermaid, application/json, application/yaml, or text/vnd.oml.code; lang=<language>. |
| `title` | string | no | One line stating the one fact the body shows, NFC, at most 100 characters, signed with the version. |
| `origin` | object | no | What kind of source the text was taken from: signed in the submission event, immutable per version, never inherited by a successor. |

**Responses.** `202` Held, visible to no one else until ratified (R3).; `409` A 409-class conflict (idempotency.*, submission.tip_conflict, workarea.frozen, review.serve_invalid, …).; `422` A 422-class refusal (submission.scan_veto, upload.digest_mismatch, settings.*, …).; `415` 415 request.unsupported_media — the request body's media type is not the application/json the operation declares; not retryable as sent.; `429` 429 limit.rate or limit.quota — retryable; Retry-After says when.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `GET /v1/memories`

Structured, paginated listing of memory summaries.

Requires: reader effective access; own=true admits any tenant role except operator (access.verb_ceiling) for its own rows only — every row the calling key authored, in every state, across all workareas minus its globally denied subtrees, no grant needed.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `workarea` | query | WorkareaRef | no | The subtree read, by id or name, which must name a node the key may be told about, else access.not_found, indistinguishable from a nonexistent node. |
| `claim_key` | query | string | no |  |
| `state` | query | `held` \| `promoted` \| `demoted` \| `rejected` \| `erased` | no |  |
| `kind` | query | `memory` \| `derived_fact` \| `steering` \| `term` \| `term_mapping` \| `vocab_release` | no |  |
| `own` | query | boolean | no |  |
| `anchor_repo` | query | string | no | Rows whose anchor names this repository, with own or without it; unanchored rows are left out. |
| `anchor_path_prefix` | query | string | no | Rows whose anchor path starts with these bytes; unanchored rows are left out. |
| `origin_kinds` | query | OriginKinds | no | Comma-separated: rows whose origin kind is one of these; rows without a kind are left out. |
| `since` | query | string | no |  |
| `until` | query | string | no |  |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Page size, at most 200. |
| `cursor` | query | string | no | Opaque, from the previous page's next_cursor. |

**Responses.** `200` One page of memory summaries.; `429` 429 limit.rate or limit.quota — retryable; Retry-After says when.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `POST /v1/memories/recall`

Ranked retrieval over promoted rows by a named search pipeline; steering rows precede hits, unranked.

Requires: reader effective access on the subtree.

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes |  |
| `workarea` | WorkareaRef | no | The subtree recalled, by id or name; omitted, the key's default_workarea. |
| `k` | integer | no |  |
| `kinds` | array of `memory` \| `derived_fact` | no | Filters hits only; an empty array is refused (request.validation), so only an absent kinds means no filter. |
| `include_text` | boolean | no | Whether each served item carries its text. |
| `anchor_repo` | string | no | A repository, scheme, credentials and.git dropped (github.com/e8kor/open-memory-lab); no segment is. or... |
| `anchor_path_prefix` | string | no | A byte prefix of the anchor path, at most 1,024 UTF-8 bytes; rows whose anchor path starts with it, unanchored rows left out. |
| `origin_kinds` | OriginKinds | no | Rows whose origin kind is one of these, combined with every other filter by AND; rows without a kind are left out. |
| `include_unreviewed` | boolean | no | When true, the calling key's own held rows (kind memory or derived_fact, never steering or retirement versions) inside subtree(scope) ∩ reader effective access, admitted by the kinds filter when one is sent as promoted hits are, join the hits, ranked in the same order, with memory.state held and unreviewed true; they count against k and max_tokens. |
| `max_tokens` | integer | no | Recall budget in budget tokens (counter oml-tc/1), at most 2^53 - 1, the largest integer the request digest canonicalizes exactly under RFC 8785. |
| `search` | `keyword-all` \| `keyword-any` \| `bm25` \| `bm25-trigram` \| `bm25-postings` \| `bm25-rerank` \| `sparse` \| `bm25-sparse` \| `bm25-sparse-rrf` \| `bm25-postings-time` | no | The search pipeline, among those the deployment serves (search.enabled); omitted, the tenant's default, else the deployment's (bm25-postings; sparse and bm25-sparse, learned sparse weights alone or fused with bm25-postings; bm25-sparse-rrf, the same two lists fused by reciprocal rank, the opt-in baseline of; bm25-postings-time, bm25-postings fused with the memories whose valid time overlaps a date the query names). |
| `match` | `any` \| `all` | no | all keeps only rows holding every query word; when none does, the any-word hits are served and search.fallback is any_term. |
| `feedback` | object | no | Which hits of this key's earlier recall answered its question and which did not. |
| `timings` | boolean | no | Omitted, false. true serves the answer's per-stage timings; refused with request.validation, details.field /timings, unless the deployment sets search.timings. |
| `include_expired` | boolean | no | true also serves memories whose valid_until has passed, which recall hides by default; get and the listings always serve them. |
| `now` | string | no | The instant the recall is read at, a period naming its first instant; omitted, the server's clock. |

**Responses.** `200` Steering first and never ranked, then scored hits.; `415` 415 request.unsupported_media — the request body's media type is not the application/json the operation declares; not retryable as sent.; `429` 429 limit.rate or limit.quota — retryable; Retry-After says when.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).

### `POST /v1/memories/{artifact_id}/supersede`

Propose a replacement version, or with retirement true propose retiring the claim; a new attributed submission, held like any write.

Requires: the supersede rule declared in docs/architecture/roles-and-keys.md (Grant admissibility and refusal order) — a writer on a target version it authored, a dreamer through edit-as-proposal.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact_id` | path | string | yes |  |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes | Claims an idempotency record (key_id, workarea, idem_key) before side effects. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `body` | string | yes | Claim text, at most submission.max_body_size (shipped 1 MiB) UTF-8 bytes of the NFC-normalized body; larger is 413 request.payload_too_large (http-api.md Limits). |
| `expected_version` | integer | yes | The claim's latest version the caller can read, as it last read it: its promoted versions where it reads the workarea and its own keys' versions; never another author's held version. |
| `anchor` | object | no | The origin the author declares: signed in the submission event, immutable per version, shown to the reviewer, never fetched by the server, and clear metadata that crypto-shredding never erases. |
| `origin` | object | no | What kind of source the text was taken from: signed in the submission event, immutable per version, never inherited by a successor. |
| `workarea` | WorkareaRef | no | When sent, the target's workarea, by id or name; any other is request.validation, details.field /workarea. |
| `retirement` | boolean | no | true proposes retiring the claim, and body states why. |
| `kind` | `memory` \| `derived_fact` \| `steering` \| `term` \| `term_mapping` \| `vocab_release` \| `guardrail` | no | Omitted, the successor takes the target's kind — the one field inherited from the target. |
| `derives_from` | array of string | no | The superseded target is included implicitly. |
| `reason` | string | no |  |
| `severity` | `never` \| `must` \| `should` | no | A guardrail's severity: never and must bind, should is the reviewed default, and it orders the set first; required on kind guardrail except a retirement, refused on every other kind (request.validation, details.field /severity). |
| `rule` | object | no | A guardrail's optional rule in the oml-gr/1 grammar: one tool class, its match and an effect, deny or ask, never allow; should takes ask only. |
| `on_similar` | `hold` \| `refuse` | no | Omitted, hold. |
| `valid_from` | string | no | When the memory begins to hold in the world, as its author declares it: a period names its first instant, so 2015 begins on 1 January 2015. |
| `valid_until` | string | no | When it stops holding: a period names its whole span, so 2015 holds through 31 December 2015 and a day through that day; an instant is exclusive. |
| `format` | string | no | The media type of body, signed with the successor and fixed for it; nothing is inherited from the target, so a format changes by supersession alone: text/plain (the default), text/markdown, text/vnd.oml.mermaid, application/json, application/yaml, or text/vnd.oml.code; lang=<language>. |
| `title` | string | no | One line stating the one fact the body shows, NFC, at most 100 characters, signed with the version. |

**Responses.** `202` The proposed replacement, held.; `409` A 409-class conflict (idempotency.*, submission.tip_conflict, workarea.frozen, review.serve_invalid, …).; `415` 415 request.unsupported_media — the request body's media type is not the application/json the operation declares; not retryable as sent.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `POST /v1/memories/{artifact_id}/source-check`

Record that a promoted version's anchored span was compared with its source at a commit.

Requires: the version's author key (writer), or a dreamer with dreamer effective access on its workarea; any other writer that can read the version is 403 access.author_only, and a key that cannot read it is 404 access.not_found.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact_id` | path | string | yes |  |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes | Claims an idempotency record (key_id, workarea, idem_key) before side effects. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rev` | string | yes | The anchor's rev grammar: with a repo anchor, 40 or 64 lower-case hex digits. |
| `result` | `fresh` \| `equivalent` \| `moved` \| `changed` \| `removed` | yes |  |
| `hash` | string | no | The span's hash at rev under the anchor's hasher; refused on an anchor without one. |
| `path` | string | no | For moved alone, required: the span's new path, under the anchor path grammar. |
| `fragment` | string | no | For moved alone: the span's new fragment, under the fragment grammar. |

**Responses.** `200` The check is journalled; the version's stale as it now reads.; `403` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).; `404` access.not_found — absent or outside read scope, indistinguishable by design.; `415` 415 request.unsupported_media — the request body's media type is not the application/json the operation declares; not retryable as sent.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `GET /v1/guardrails`

The guardrails in force at the scope node, under the key's reader access and guardrail scope; never in recall.

Requires: reader on the scope node.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `workarea` | query | string | no | The scope node, by id or name, within the key's grants; omitted, the key's default workarea. |

**Responses.** `200` The set, its digest and the caller's own held guardrails.; `401` auth.missing or auth.invalid.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).

### `POST /v2/workareas`

Create a child workarea in development.

Requires: admin key role. parent and crew each take an id or a name, and parent_id, the v0.3.0 spelling, is refused with request.validation, details.renamed_to /parent; a crew that names no crew record of the tenant answers access.not_found, checked after the parent and before name.taken. name must be unique in the tenant (409 name.taken, checked after every other check; universe is always taken, by the root).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes | Claims an idempotency record (key_id, workarea, idem_key) before side effects. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `parent` | WorkareaRef | no | The parent. |
| `name` | string | yes | A new name, in a creation body: the creation grammar. |
| `crew` | CrewRef | no | A crew record, by its id or its name, resolved server-side like every reference. |

**Responses.** `201` The new node.; `409` A 409-class conflict (idempotency.*, submission.tip_conflict, workarea.frozen, review.serve_invalid, …).; `415` 415 request.unsupported_media — the request body's media type is not the application/json the operation declares; not retryable as sent.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `GET /v2/workareas/{workarea}`

One node — id, parent, derived path, status, crew record — with the calling key's view of it.

Requires: reader effective access (access.not_found otherwise), or the admin key role, which reads the structure of every workarea in its tenant without grants and never claim content — for an admin key every child and edge is present and my_effective_verbs is empty. children, my_effective_verbs and permission_epoch are relative to the calling key: children (ordered by path_leaf, then id) and edges (ordered by edge_id) outside read access are absent; my_effective_verbs is the union over the grant roles effective on the node (the effective-verbs table in docs/architecture/roles-and-keys.md); permission_epoch is the calling key's permission epoch as declared in docs/architecture/workareas.md.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `workarea` | path | WorkareaRef | yes |  |

**Responses.** `200` The node.; `404` access.not_found — absent or outside read scope, indistinguishable by design.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).

### `POST /v2/workareas/{workarea}/mode`

A person's key puts a workarea in progress, or commits it back to standard.

Requires: a dreamer key held_by human with dreamer effective access on the node; every other key is refused before any lookup with access.verb_ceiling, details.reason mode_is_human_only. in_progress is refused with 409 workarea.in_progress_refused, details.reason universe, status (not development) or nested (an ancestor or descendant is in progress). standard on an in-progress root is its commit, refused with 409 workarea.held_remaining while any version in its subtree is held, dead-lettered ones included.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `workarea` | path | WorkareaRef | yes |  |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes | Claims an idempotency record (key_id, workarea, idem_key) before side effects. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `in_progress` \| `standard` | yes | in_progress puts the node in progress; standard on an in-progress root is its commit. |

**Responses.** `200` The node as the key reads it.; `415` 415 request.unsupported_media — the request body's media type is not the application/json the operation declares; not retryable as sent.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).

## keys

Key issuance, the calling key's own record, connect codes and bootstrap.

| Operation | What it does |
|---|---|
| `POST /v2/keys` | Issue a key under the issuer ceiling; the value appears exactly once, here. |
| `GET /v2/whoami` | The calling key's own record — role, name, tenant, default workarea, crew and grants. |
| `GET /v2/keys/{key}` | One key — grants, denials, epoch, issuance and revocation events. |
| `POST /v2/keys/{key}/denials` | Create or extend the key's global deny object — deny-wins across all its grants. |
| `POST /v2/keys/{key}/connect-codes` | Mint a fresh one-time connect code for a connector key; voids the key's earlier codes. |
| `POST /v2/keys/{key}/connections/{connection_id}/revoke` | Journalled revocation of one connection. |
| `POST /v2/bootstrap/claim` | Exchange the deployment's single-use enrollment token for the root operator key — the bootstrap ceremony's one API call. |

### `POST /v2/keys`

Issue a key under the issuer ceiling; the value appears exactly once, here.

Requires: admin key role; operator key role only for an operator key, sent without tenant, or a tenant's first admin key, sent with tenant (step 0 of the issuance order). expiry and tenant are designed fields (openapi-designed.yaml x-oml-designed-fields), each refused with request.validation until it is built, so an operator key issues operator keys only.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes | Claims an idempotency record (key_id, workarea, idem_key) before side effects. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | `reader` \| `writer` \| `dreamer` \| `admin` \| `operator` | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes | The key's name: unique in its namespace (409 name.taken), never changed, never released; distinct from principal and label. |
| `grants` | array of object | no | Taken exactly as sent, except that a user key also gets a reader grant on the universe node alone. |
| `user` | string | no | The person the key acts for, by the user's name: a user key, whose every grant must lie in its user root universe.<user> (403 access.issuer_ceiling, details user) and whose workarea references resolve in that root's namespace. |
| `default_workarea` | WorkareaRef | no | The provider-ring target, by id or name; its validation and its default when omitted are declared in the issuance order of docs/architecture/roles-and-keys.md. |
| `held_by` | `agent` \| `human` \| `service` | no | The issuing admin's journalled attestation; never verified as fact. |
| `crew` | CrewRef | no | The key's crew record, by id or name, journalled as crew_id and fixed for the key's life; one that names no crew record of the tenant answers access.not_found at step 4 of the issuance order. |
| `label` | string | no | A free-text note; unique nowhere. |
| `principal` | string | no | Who acts — the attribution identity, shared across one identity's keys; free text. |
| `guardrail_scope` | `workarea` \| `ancestors` | no | Which applicable guardrails the key loads: workarea, the scope node's alone; ancestors, the node's and every ancestor's the key reads. |
| `profile` | `curator` | no | curator: a dreamer key held by an agent that may reject, propose retirements and summaries, and flag contradictions inside an in-progress workarea only, and never approves; any other role or held_by is request.validation, details.field /profile. |
| `connect_code` | boolean | no | Issue a connector key: no bearer value is minted, and the 201 carries connect_code in place of value. |

**Responses.** `201` The key, value shown once.; `403` A 403-class refusal naming its rule (access.*, review.*, simulation.audience_refused).; `415` 415 request.unsupported_media — the request body's media type is not the application/json the operation declares; not retryable as sent.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `GET /v2/whoami`

The calling key's own record — role, name, tenant, default workarea, crew and grants.

Requires: any live key; it reads only its own record.

**Responses.** `200` The calling key's own record.; `401` auth.missing or auth.invalid.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `GET /v2/keys/{key}`

One key — grants, denials, epoch, issuance and revocation events.

Requires: admin key role.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | path | KeyRef | yes |  |

**Responses.** `200` The key.; `404` access.not_found — absent or outside read scope, indistinguishable by design.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).

Create or extend the key's global deny object — deny-wins across all its grants.

Requires: admin key role.

## oauth

OAuth endpoints for hosted MCP clients, served only where `oauth.issuer` is set.

| Operation | What it does |
|---|---|
| `GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp` | RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata for the /mcp resource; 404 where oauth.issuer is unset. |
| `GET /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` | RFC 8414 authorization server metadata; 404 where oauth.issuer is unset. |
| `GET /oauth/authorize` | Start an authorization request — validates the client, redirect URI and S256 PKCE, then renders the connect-code page. |
| `POST /oauth/authorize` | The page's own form — the connect code, then the confirmation. |
| `POST /oauth/token` | Exchange an authorization code, or rotate a refresh token, for an access token and a new refresh token. |
| `POST /oauth/register` | RFC 7591 dynamic client registration, the fallback to metadata documents; public clients only, redirect URIs inside the allowlist. |

### `GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp`

RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata for the /mcp resource; 404 where oauth.issuer is unset.

**Responses.** `200` The document.; `404` Connections are not configured on this deployment.


### `GET /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`

RFC 8414 authorization server metadata; 404 where oauth.issuer is unset.

**Responses.** `200` The document.; `404` Connections are not configured on this deployment.


### `GET /oauth/authorize`

Start an authorization request — validates the client, redirect URI and S256 PKCE, then renders the connect-code page.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `response_type` | query | `code` | yes |  |
| `client_id` | query | string | yes | An https metadata-document URL in the admitted form (no userinfo, fragment, query, dot segment, percent-encoded / or., non-default port or IP-literal host; its own WHATWG serialization), or a client_id that POST /oauth/register minted. |
| `redirect_uri` | query | string | no | Exactly one of the client's registered URIs, inside the allowlist (exactly https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback), matched byte for byte on the value after exactly one application/x-www-form-urlencoded decoding, never after URL parsing or any further decoding; optional for a client with exactly one. |
| `code_challenge` | query | string | no | Required by the flow: absent, it is oauth.pkce_required, redirected once the client and the redirect URI are accepted. |
| `code_challenge_method` | query | `S256` | no | Required by the flow: absent (which RFC 7636 §4.3 reads as plain) or anything but S256, it is oauth.pkce_required, redirected once the client and the redirect URI are accepted. |
| `state` | query | string | no | At most 512 bytes; echoed verbatim on the redirect, percent-encoded as a query parameter. |
| `resource` | query | string | no | When sent, exactly <issuer>/mcp. |
| `scope` | query | `mcp` | no |  |

**Responses.** `200` The connect-code page.; `302` A refusal after the redirect URI was validated (oauth.pkce_required, oauth.resource_mismatch, request.validation), redirected with error, error_description, state and iss.; `400` A refusal page naming its code (request.validation for a parameter past its bound, oauth.client_invalid, oauth.redirect_refused).


### `POST /oauth/authorize`

The page's own form — the connect code, then the confirmation.

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`): object

**Responses.** `200` The confirmation page.; `303` The redirect to the client, with code, state and iss, or with error, state and iss.; `400` The form again, or a refusal page naming its code (oauth.connect_code_invalid, oauth.authorization_expired, request.validation).; `403` The refusal page for a submission that fails the origin check, oauth.origin_refused; never redirected, and no attempt is consumed.


### `POST /oauth/token`

Exchange an authorization code, or rotate a refresh token, for an access token and a new refresh token.

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`)

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grant_type` | `authorization_code` \| `refresh_token` | yes |  |
| `client_id` | string | yes |  |
| `code` | string | no | authorization_code only. |
| `redirect_uri` | string | no | authorization_code only. |
| `code_verifier` | string | no | authorization_code only; S256 against the authorization request's code_challenge. |
| `refresh_token` | string | no | refresh_token only. |
| `resource` | string | no | When sent, exactly <issuer>/mcp. |
| `scope` | `mcp` | no |  |

**Responses.** `200` The token pair.; `400` An RFC 6749 error: oauth.authorization_code_invalid, oauth.refresh_invalid (invalid_grant, a code or token issued to another client included), oauth.client_invalid (invalid_client, for a request that sends a client_secret in the body), oauth.resource_mismatch (invalid_target), request.validation (invalid_request, unsupported_grant_type, invalid_scope).; `401` oauth.client_invalid as invalid_client, for a request that sends an Authorization header: every client is public (RFC 6749 §5.2).; `415` A body other than application/x-www-form-urlencoded, as invalid_request.


### `POST /oauth/register`

RFC 7591 dynamic client registration, the fallback to metadata documents; public clients only, redirect URIs inside the allowlist.

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `redirect_uris` | array of string | yes | Each inside the allowlist: exactly https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback, matched byte for byte on the JSON string value, never after URL parsing or any further decoding. |
| `client_name` | string | yes | Required, since the authorization page shows it; absent, it is request.validation (invalid_client_metadata). |
| `token_endpoint_auth_method` | `none` | no | Absent, it is registered as none and echoed as none; any other value is request.validation (invalid_client_metadata). |
| `grant_types` | array of `authorization_code` \| `refresh_token` | no |  |
| `response_types` | array of `code` | no |  |

**Responses.** `201` Registered.; `400` An RFC 7591 error: oauth.redirect_refused (invalid_redirect_uri), request.validation (invalid_client_metadata).; `429` limit.rate — the cap on unused registrations; Retry-After says when.


## web

| Operation | What it does |
|---|---|
| `GET /v2/web/emails` | The tenant's email allowlist — who may sign in to the user and admin pages, as which user, and whether as an admin. |
| `POST /v2/web/emails` | Add an email to the allowlist, or change the user or admin flag of one already there. |
| `POST /v2/web/emails/remove` | Remove an email from the allowlist, ending its sessions; the user's agent keys keep working. |
| `GET /v2/web/users` | The people of the tenant with their quota use and limits, and the pending deletion requests. |
| `GET /web` | The sign-in page without a session; the user page with one. |
| `POST /web` | One act of the user page, named by action. |
| `POST /web/sign-in` | Start a provider's sign-in — the code flow with S256 PKCE, state and, for Google, a nonce. |
| `GET /web/callback/{provider}` | The provider's redirect; admits a listed, verified email and starts a session. |
| `GET /web/data/memories` | The user page's page of memories as JSON. |
| `GET /web/admin/data/memories` | The admin page's page of memories as JSON. |
| `GET /web/admin` | The admin page, for a session whose allowlist entry is an admin's. |
| `POST /web/admin` | One act of the admin page, named by action, run as the capacity it needs. |
| `POST /web/sign-up` | Accept the terms and create the account, in open sign-up. |
| `GET /web/start` | The onboarding page; the sign-in page without a session. |
| `POST /web/start` | One act of the onboarding page, named by action. |
| `GET /web/start/status` | Whether the person's agent has connected and the state of their newest memory. |
| `GET /web/start/export` | Everything the person holds, as a JSON download. |
| `GET /web/admin/users` | The admin's users page — quota use, quotas and pending deletion requests. |
| `POST /web/admin/users` | One act of the users page, named by action, run as <user>-admin. |

### `GET /v2/web/emails`

The tenant's email allowlist — who may sign in to the user and admin pages, as which user, and whether as an admin.

Requires: admin key role.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Page size, at most 200. |
| `cursor` | query | string | no | The next_cursor of the page before: the digest of its last entry's email, never an address. |

**Responses.** `200` The allowlist.; `403` A 403-class refusal naming its rule (access.*, review.*, simulation.audience_refused).; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `POST /v2/web/emails`

Add an email to the allowlist, or change the user or admin flag of one already there.

Requires: admin key role.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes | Claims an idempotency record (key_id, workarea, idem_key) before side effects. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | yes |  |
| `user` | string | yes | A name under the creation grammar, at most 56 characters. |
| `admin` | boolean | yes |  |

**Responses.** `200` The entry as stored.; `403` A 403-class refusal naming its rule (access.*, review.*, simulation.audience_refused).; `409` A 409-class conflict (idempotency.*, submission.tip_conflict, workarea.frozen, review.serve_invalid, …).; `415` 415 request.unsupported_media — the request body's media type is not the application/json the operation declares; not retryable as sent.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `POST /v2/web/emails/remove`

Remove an email from the allowlist, ending its sessions; the user's agent keys keep working.

Requires: admin key role.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes | Claims an idempotency record (key_id, workarea, idem_key) before side effects. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | yes |  |

**Responses.** `200` Removed.; `403` A 403-class refusal naming its rule (access.*, review.*, simulation.audience_refused).; `404` access.not_found — absent or outside read scope, indistinguishable by design.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `GET /v2/web/users`

The people of the tenant with their quota use and limits, and the pending deletion requests.

Requires: admin key role. mode is signup.mode; address_limit_shared is true when no proxy is trusted, so every sign-up shares one address limit. under_quotas marks the people of the sign-up tenant. oml doctor reads it for its quota and signup lines.

**Responses.** `200` The people and the pending requests.; `403` A 403-class refusal naming its rule (access.*, review.*, simulation.audience_refused).; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).

## admin

An administrator's reads of memory text and attribution.

| Operation | What it does |
|---|---|
| `POST /v2/admin/memories/search` | Search every memory of the tenant, in every state, workarea and user root, with its text and attribution. |
| `GET /v2/admin/memories/{artifact_id}` | One memory of the tenant with its text and full attribution, a universe claim with its source. |
| `GET /v2/admin/rescan` | Rescan the versions the tenant stores with the server's rule set and report what it would refuse or hold, by rule and place, never the text. |
| `GET /v2/admin/accounts/{account}/usage` | One account's meters against its limits this UTC month. |
| `PUT /v2/admin/accounts/{account}/profile` | Set an account's quota profile and its overrides, replacing the ones it had. |
| `GET /v2/admin/usage` | The usage ledger of one UTC month, every account, one row per account per closed day, as JSON or CSV. |
| `GET /v2/admin/usage/drift` | Each account whose counters differ from the rows they count, and each account on a profile the configuration does not declare. |

### `POST /v2/admin/memories/search`

Search every memory of the tenant, in every state, workarea and user root, with its text and attribution.

Requires: admin key role; the operator and every other role answer access.verb_ceiling. query is the recall full-text search without the visibility filter; state and workarea narrow it.

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | no |  |
| `workarea` | string | no |  |
| `state` | `held` \| `promoted` \| `rejected` \| `superseded` \| `demoted` | no |  |
| `limit` | integer | no |  |
| `cursor` | string | no |  |

**Responses.** `200` A page of memories with text and attribution.; `403` A 403-class refusal naming its rule (access.*, review.*, simulation.audience_refused).; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `GET /v2/admin/memories/{artifact_id}`

One memory of the tenant with its text and full attribution, a universe claim with its source.

Requires: admin key role.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact_id` | path | string | yes |  |

**Responses.** `200` The memory with its attribution.; `403` A 403-class refusal naming its rule (access.*, review.*, simulation.audience_refused).; `404` access.not_found — absent or outside read scope, indistinguishable by design.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `GET /v2/admin/rescan`

Rescan the versions the tenant stores with the server's rule set and report what it would refuse or hold, by rule and place, never the text.

Requires: admin key role; every other role answers access.verb_ceiling.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `after_seq` | query | integer | no | Rescan the submissions journalled after this sequence number. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | The most journal events this window reads. |

**Responses.** `200` What this window found.; `403` A 403-class refusal naming its rule (access.*, review.*, simulation.audience_refused).; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `GET /v2/admin/accounts/{account}/usage`

One account's meters against its limits this UTC month.

Requires: admin key role; every other role answers access.verb_ceiling. account is the root workarea's id or the user's name, in the admin's tenant; anything else answers access.not_found.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | path | string | yes | The account: its root workarea id or its user name. |

**Responses.** `200` The account's usage.; `403` A 403-class refusal naming its rule (access.*, review.*, simulation.audience_refused).; `404` access.not_found — absent or outside read scope, indistinguishable by design.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `PUT /v2/admin/accounts/{account}/profile`

Set an account's quota profile and its overrides, replacing the ones it had.

Requires: admin key role. profile names a profile the configuration declares, or request.validation with details.field profile; overrides maps a quota to its limit, each from 0 to that quota's maximum (1,000,000, or 1,000,000,000,000 for text_bytes), and an unknown quota is request.validation with details.field overrides.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | path | string | yes | The account: its root workarea id or its user name. |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | string | yes |  |
| `overrides` | object | no | A quota's limit for this account alone: memories, text_bytes, writes_per_month, keys, connections or requests_per_minute. |

**Responses.** `200` The account's usage under its new limits.; `400` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).; `403` A 403-class refusal naming its rule (access.*, review.*, simulation.audience_refused).; `404` access.not_found — absent or outside read scope, indistinguishable by design.; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `GET /v2/admin/usage`

The usage ledger of one UTC month, every account, one row per account per closed day, as JSON or CSV.

Requires: admin key role. period is the month, YYYY-MM, and required; format is json, the default, or csv, whose header is day,account,user,profile,memories,text_bytes,writes,recalls,keys,connections.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `period` | query | string | yes | The UTC month, YYYY-MM. |
| `format` | query | `json` \| `csv` | no |  |

**Responses.** `200` The month's rows, by day then account.; `400` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).; `403` A 403-class refusal naming its rule (access.*, review.*, simulation.audience_refused).; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).


### `GET /v2/admin/usage/drift`

Each account whose counters differ from the rows they count, and each account on a profile the configuration does not declare.

Requires: admin key role.

**Responses.** `200` The drift report; two empty lists when every counter matches.; `403` A 403-class refusal naming its rule (access.*, review.*, simulation.audience_refused).; `default` Typed error envelope; code is one of ErrorCode (docs/api/errors.md).
